drafts.name: Venue or host space inquiry
drafts.purpose: Get comparable quotes and terms from two or three spaces.
must_include: questions: what's included, deposit and cancellation, weather policy, insurance requirements, end time and noise rules, accessibility, load-in and parking, preferred or required vendors
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Event inquiry for {date_short}: {event_name}

Hi [name],

I run {business_name} and I'm planning a {event_type_lower} for about {headcount} guests on {date_long}, from {time_window}, with a backup date of [backup date]. We'd need access from [setup time] for setup and until [teardown time] to clear out.

Could you tell me:
1. Is the space available on either date, and what's the cost for those hours?
2. What's included (tables, chairs, sound, Wi-Fi, cleanup), and what's extra?
3. The deposit, payment dates, and cancellation and weather terms?
4. Insurance you require from us and from our vendors?
5. Any rules on end time, noise, decorations, food, drink or outside vendors?
6. Step-free access, restrooms, parking and the load-in route?

Happy to visit. Thanks so much,
{owner_name}
{business_name}

drafts.name: Caterer inquiry
drafts.purpose: Get comparable food quotes.
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Catering quote for {date_short}: about {headcount} guests

Hi [name],

I'm planning a {event_type_lower} on {date_long} at {venue_name}, with food served from [serving time]. We expect about {headcount} guests and are thinking of {food_style}.

Could you send a quote, including:
1. Suggested menu and price per person or per item
2. Staff, rentals, setup and cleanup: included or extra?
3. How you handle allergies and dietary needs ([list any you know])
4. Deposit, payment dates and cancellation terms
5. The date you need our final headcount
6. Your insurance certificate and any permits for serving at {venue_name}

Thank you,
{owner_name}

drafts.name: Vendor inquiry (photographer, entertainment, speaker, food seller)
drafts.purpose: Check availability, price and needs for one vendor.
must_include: what you want them to do

drafts.name: Rentals inquiry
drafts.purpose: Reserve tables, chairs, tent, linens or sound.
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Rental quote for {date_short}

Hi [name],

Could you quote the following for {date_long} at {venue_address}?
[item and quantity list]

Please include delivery and pickup windows, whether your team sets up, the deposit, and your terms for weather and cancellation.

Thank you,
{owner_name}

drafts.name: Booking confirmation (put the deal in writing)
drafts.purpose: Recap the agreed terms so both sides have the same record.
must_include: price, deposit, balance and due dates
cancellation terms as you understood them
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Confirming {event_name} on {date_short}

Hi [name],

Thanks for confirming. Here's what I have, so we're on the same page:
- Date and times: {date_long}, access from [time], event {time_window}, cleared by [time]
- Included: [list]
- Price: [total], deposit [amount] paid on [date], balance [amount] due [date]
- Cancellation and weather: [as agreed]
- Day-of contact: {owner_name}, [phone]

Please let me know if anything here differs from your records.

Best,
{owner_name}

drafts.name: Certificate of insurance request
drafts.purpose: Collect proof of a vendor's insurance before the event.

drafts.name: Final details to a vendor
drafts.purpose: Confirm logistics a week or so out.
must_include: arrival and setup time and place
final amount and when it's paid
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Final details for {date_short}: {event_name}

Hi [name],

Looking forward to {date_weekday}! The final details:
- Arrival: [time] at [entrance], setup in [location]
- Parking and load-in: [details]
- Doors open {start_time}; you're on from [time] to [time]
- Day-of contact: [name], [phone]
- Final amount: [amount], paid [how and when]

Anything you need from us before then?

Thanks,
{owner_name}

drafts.name: Thank-you to vendors, partners and volunteers
drafts.purpose: Say thanks specifically and keep the relationship.
must_include: one specific thing they did well
an offer of a review or referral

drafts.name: Polite no-thank-you to a vendor not chosen
drafts.purpose: Close the loop kindly with vendors who quoted.
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Thanks for your quote

Hi [name],

Thank you for the quote for {event_name}. We've gone another way this time, but I appreciated your quick, clear reply and would be glad to ask you again.

Best,
{owner_name}

drafts.name: Sponsorship or in-kind donation ask
drafts.purpose: Invite a local business to support the fundraiser.
must_include: that the charity has approved the use of its name, if it has
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Would {sponsor_name} help us support [cause]?

Hi [name],

On {date_long}, {business_name} is hosting {event_name} to raise money for [cause], with a goal of [goal]. I'm reaching out to a few neighbors we admire.

Would you consider [the ask]? In return we'd [thank you on signs and posts / a table / a mention from the stage]. If you can let me know by [date], we'll include you in all the materials.

Thank you for considering it,
{owner_name}

drafts.name: Save the date
drafts.purpose: Get the date on calendars early.

drafts.name: Invitation
drafts.purpose: Invite guests with everything they need to say yes.
must_include: how to respond and by when

drafts.name: RSVP or ticket reminder
drafts.purpose: Nudge people who haven't responded.
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Still hoping to see you on {date_weekday}

Quick reminder that {event_name} is on {date_long}, {time_window}, at {venue_name}. [One reason to come.] [RSVP link] by [date] so we can plan for you.

drafts.name: Know before you go
drafts.purpose: Smooth arrival for confirmed guests.
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: See you tomorrow: {event_name}

We're all set for tomorrow, {date_long}, from {start_time}.
- Address and entrance: {venue_address}, [entrance]
- Parking: [details]
- Accessibility: [step-free entrance, seating, restrooms]
- Bring: [ticket, ID, nothing at all]
- Questions on the day: [phone]

drafts.name: Weather update
drafts.purpose: Tell guests and vendors the weather call, the same day it's made.
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Weather update for {event_name}

[We're still on, moving inside to (place) / postponing to (date).] [What guests should do differently.] Everything else stays the same. Thanks for rolling with it!

drafts.name: Thank-you to guests
drafts.purpose: Thank guests and give them a next step.

drafts.name: Follow-up to new contacts
drafts.purpose: Turn a visit into a relationship, only for people who agreed to hear from you.

drafts.name: Feedback survey
drafts.purpose: Learn what to repeat and change.
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Two minutes to help us do it better?

1. How would you rate {event_name}? (1 to 5)
2. What was the best part?
3. What would you change?
4. Would you come to the next one? (Yes, maybe, no)

drafts.name: Announcement post
drafts.purpose: Announce the event.
drafts.skeleton: [Hook]. Join us for {event_name} on {date_short}, {time_window}, at {venue_name}. [What's happening.] [Sign-up link or 'no RSVP needed'.] [Image idea.]

drafts.name: Behind-the-scenes post
drafts.purpose: Keep momentum.
drafts.skeleton: [A real prep moment.] {event_name} is {days_to_go} days away. [Small teaser.]

drafts.name: One-week countdown post
drafts.purpose: Remind and excite.
must_include: one specific thing guests will see or get
drafts.skeleton: One week until {event_name}! [One specific thing.] {date_short}, {time_window}, {venue_name}.

drafts.name: Day-before post
drafts.purpose: Last call.
drafts.skeleton: Tomorrow! {event_name}, {time_window} at {venue_name}. [One reason not to miss it.]

drafts.name: Live post
drafts.purpose: Share the moment.
drafts.skeleton: [Photo idea.] We're live at {venue_name} until [time]. Come say hi!

drafts.name: Recap post
drafts.purpose: Thank and show the result.
drafts.skeleton: Thank you to everyone who came to {event_name}! [Real highlight or result.] [Thanks to partners, with their permission.]

drafts.name: Ready-to-share text for partners
drafts.purpose: Make it easy for partners to promote.
drafts.skeleton: We're excited to be part of {event_name} with {business_name} on {date_short} at {venue_name}! [Link.]

drafts.name: Event listing blurb
drafts.purpose: One description for every calendar.
must_include: what, when, where, cost, how to sign up
drafts.skeleton: {event_name}: [what it is in one sentence]. {date_long}, {time_window}, at {venue_name}, {venue_address}. [Cost or free.] [How to sign up.]

drafts.name: Local press or newsletter note
drafts.purpose: Pitch a short story.
drafts.skeleton:
Subject: Local story: {event_name} on {date_short}

Hi [name],

[What's new and why it matters locally, in two sentences.] {event_name} is on {date_long} at {venue_name}, {time_window}, and it's [free / ticketed].

Happy to share photos or answer questions: {owner_name}, [phone or email].

drafts.name: Staff and volunteer brief
drafts.purpose: Everyone knows their job.
must_include: what to do if something goes wrong
drafts.skeleton:
{event_name}: team brief for {date_long}
Goal: {goal}
Arrive: [time]. Doors: {start_time}. Wrap: [time].
Roles: [name: job] for each person
Where things are: [check-in, supplies, first aid kit, restrooms, exits]
Ask: [lead name and phone]
If something goes wrong: [safety plan in one line, and who calls emergency services]

drafts.name: Run of show
drafts.purpose: A shared minute-by-minute plan.
must_include: setup to teardown in time order
drafts.skeleton:
{event_name}, {date_long}, run of show
[time]  Setup starts: [who]
[time]  [Vendor] arrives at [entrance]: contact [phone]
[time]  Sound, lights, Wi-Fi and payments test: [who]
{start_time}  Doors open: [who greets]
[time]  [Peak moment: welcome, reveal, demo]: [who]
[time]  Last call or closing words: [who]
[time]  Teardown and cleanup: [who]
Backup notes: [weather, no-shows, power]
